feed.title: Scarface decomp: new matches
feed.subtitle: Functions of Scarface: The World Is Yours rebuilt in C++ that compiles to the exact same bytes.

entry.title: sub_002CC7F0 (Xbox, 1210 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
entry.summary: Builds a Huffman decoding table from a list of code lengths (zlib 1.2.1's inflate_table). 0x002CC7F0 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.summary: Decodes literals and matches quickly while there is plenty of input and output room (zlib 1.2.1's inflate_fast). 0x002CC380 in the Xbox version, matched byte for byte with its original.

entry.title: sub_002C6ED0 (Xbox, 199 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)

entry.title: sub_002C6E60 (Xbox, 24 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)

entry.title: sub_002C6B80 (Xbox, 722 bytes) by RRutherrfordd (Founder)
